extraction_report.paper_summary: RegFormer is a foundation model for single-cell RNA-seq that integrates gene regulatory network priors via graph topological sorting and a Mamba block architecture. It uses dual embeddings (value + token) and is pretrained on large-scale single-cell data to produce cell and gene embeddings for downstream tasks: cell embedding/annotation, GRN construction, perturbation prediction, and drug response prediction.
